```{r}
#| include: false

source(here::here("_common.R"))

due <- get_schedule() %>%
  filter(n_assign == params$number) %>%
  pull(due_assign) %>%
  paste0(" by 11:59pm")

build_dir <- paste0("build", params$number)
```

> **Due**: `r due`
>
> **Grading**: Graded 0 / 0.5 / 1 using the
> [build rubric](../syllabus.qmd#build-rubric). Together, the builds are worth
> 25% of your final grade (lowest build dropped).
>
> **Purpose**: `r params$purpose`
>
> **Deliverable**: Submit your work in the ``r build_dir`` folder of your course
> repo (`bwai-f27/bwai-netID`). Include your build and a `transcript.md` file of
> your work with the AI (run `/export` in Claude Code to make it). From Build 5
> on, also include a **token usage report**. Make every commit yourself in GitHub
> Desktop: never let the agent commit for you. Scrub API keys and personal data
> from transcripts before submitting.
